mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, standard_id, standard_name, id, serial_number, classify_id, basic_class, specification, quantity, mete, unit_net, length, width, thickness, brand, heat_no_and_batch_no, color, remark, project_id, workshop_id, warehouse_id, material_returnable_id, return_id, move_weighted_average, price_excluding_VAT, amount, amount_excluding_vat, input_vat, invoice_type, material_is_whole, tax_rate, theory_thickness
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(ifnull(wrd.mete, 0)), 0) mete, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wrd.quantity, 0)), 0) quantity, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wrd.input_VAT, 0)), 0) inputVAT, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wrd.amount, 0)), 0) amount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(wrd.amount_excluding_VAT, 0)), 0) amountExcludingVAT, (select price_excluding_vat from wms_return_detail order by create_time desc LIMIT 1) unitPriceExcludingVAT from wms_return_detail wrd left join wms_return wr on wr.id = wrd.return_id where wrd.weighted_average_price_id = #{wapId} and wr.review_status = 2 and wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0

select wrd.*, p.id pid, p.short_name psName, p.serial_number pSN, p.name pn, pm.name pmName, pa.name paName, mbf.id mbfId, mbf.name mbfName, wm.measure_unit wmu, wm.measure_precision wmp, wm.accounting_unit wau, wm.accounting_precision wap, ww.id wwId, ww.name wwName from wms_return_detail wrd left join contract_project p on p.id = wrd.project_id left join wms_workshop mbf on wrd.workshop_id = mbf.id left join wms_warehouse ww on ww.id = wrd.warehouse_id left join wms_measure wm on wm.classification_id = wrd.classify_id left join plan_monomer pm on pm.id = wrd.monomer_id left join plan_area pa on pa.id = wrd.area_id where wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wrd.return_id = #{id}

select CASE WHEN #{amountType} = 1 THEN ifnull(sum(wrd.amount), 0) WHEN #{amountType} = 2 THEN ifnull(sum(wrd.amount_excluding_vat), 0) end from wms_return_detail wrd left join wms_return wr on wr.id = wrd.return_id where wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wr.review_status = 2 AND wrd.project_id = #{projectId} and wrd.basic_class & 7 > 0

select ifnull(sum(wrd.mete),0) from wms_return_detail wrd left join wms_return wr on wr.id = wrd.return_id where wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 and wr.review_status = 2 and wrd.project_id = #{projectId} and DATE_FORMAT(wr.review_time, '%y') = #{year} and wrd.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0

SELECT wrd.* FROM wms_material_returnable wmr LEFT JOIN wms_return_detail wrd ON wmr.id = wrd.material_returnable_id LEFT JOIN wms_return wr ON wr.id = wrd.return_id WHERE find_in_set(wmr.outbound_detail_id,#{ids}) and wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2

SELECT wrd.* FROM wms_material_returnable wmr LEFT JOIN wms_return_detail wrd ON wmr.id = wrd.material_returnable_id LEFT JOIN wms_return wr ON wr.id = wrd.return_id WHERE wmr.outbound_detail_id=#{id} and wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2

SELECT wrd.* FROM wms_return_detail wrd LEFT JOIN wms_return wr ON wr.id = wrd.return_id WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 AND wrd.material_returnable_id in
#{materialReturnableId}

select sum(a.amount_excluding_vat) from wms_return_detail a left join wms_return b on a.return_id = b.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.classify_id = #{classifyId} and b.review_status = 2 and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y%m') = #{date}

select ifnull(sum(a.mete),0) from wms_return_detail a left join wms_return b on a.return_id = b.id where a.bool_delete_enum = 0 and b.review_status = 2 and b.bool_delete_enum = 0 and a.basic_class & #{basicClass} > 0 and DATE_FORMAT(a.create_time, '%Y%m') = #{year}

SELECT ifnull(sum(wrd.quantity),0) quantity, ifnull(sum(wrd.mete),0) mete, ifnull(sum(wrd.amount),0) amount, ifnull(sum(wrd.amount_excluding_VAT),0) amountExcludingVat FROM wms_material_returnable wmr LEFT JOIN wms_return_detail wrd ON wmr.id = wrd.material_returnable_id LEFT JOIN wms_return wr ON wr.id = wrd.return_id WHERE wmr.outbound_detail_id = #{id} and wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2

SELECT wrd.project_id as id, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.mete ), 0) / 1000000 as mete FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd LEFT JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wrd.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 AND wo.outbound_type_selection = 1 AND wrd.basic_class & 263 > 0 GROUP BY wrd.project_id

SELECT wmr.workshop_id as id, IFNULL( SUM( wrd.mete ), 0) / 1000000 as mete FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd LEFT JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wrd.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_material_returnable wmr ON wrd.material_returnable_id = wmr.id AND wmr.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 AND wo.outbound_type_selection = 1 AND wrd.basic_class & 263 > 0 GROUP BY wmr.workshop_id

SELECT IFNULL( SUM( wrd.mete ), 0) as mete FROM wms_return_detail AS wrd LEFT JOIN wms_return AS wr ON wrd.return_id = wr.id AND wr.bool_delete_enum = 0 LEFT JOIN wms_outbound wo ON wrd.outbound_id = wo.id AND wo.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE wrd.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND wr.review_status = 2 AND wo.outbound_type_selection in(1,128) AND wrd.project_id = #{projectId} AND wrd.classify_id = #{classifyId}
